strategy.overview: Hi-Deal builds Bonus through the upper spinner route and five card targets. Send controlled shots up the left spinner or right orbit until Bonus reaches 15,000. Complete 10-J-Q-K-A to raise the spinner to 1,000 per spin; only then consider the riskier center saucer.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Hi-Deal, shoot the left spinner or right orbit to build Bonus toward 15,000. Complete the 10-J-Q-K-A targets to light the spinner for 1,000 per spin, then keep shooting that spinner. The center saucer grows with completed cards but is a much riskier collect.
strategy.summary: Build and double the 15,000 Bonus through repeatable top shots. Complete the five cards to light the spinner, then favor the lit spinner over the center saucer. A lit return or outlane can award Extra Ball when enabled.

quickInfo.name: Build Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Use lit top rollovers, return lanes, lit red targets, and the center saucer; Bonus stops at 15,000.

quickInfo.name: Complete 10-J-Q-K-A
quickInfo.summary: Light the spinner for 1,000 per spin, the center saucer for Special, and alternating return lanes for Extra Ball.

quickInfo.name: Center saucer
quickInfo.summary: Score 1,000 and one Bonus advance for each card completed during the current ball.

quickInfo.name: Right orbit
quickInfo.summary: Can light for Double Bonus on an adjustable mystery basis.

steps.text: Shoot the left spinner or right orbit to send the ball through the top rollovers and build Bonus.
Continue until Bonus reaches its 15,000 maximum; take the right orbit whenever Double Bonus is lit.
Hit the 10-J-Q-K-A standups when their rebounds are controllable.
After all five cards are complete, shoot the lit left spinner for 1,000 per spin.
Use the center saucer only when its accumulated card value justifies the miss and rebound risk.

buildsToward.title: A doubled 15,000 Bonus and a lit 1,000-point spinner

steps.text: Build Bonus through repeatable top shots.
Collect the right orbit when Double Bonus is lit.
Complete the five cards, then repeat the lit left spinner.

machineSetup: Confirm Extra Ball and Special conversion, tilt penalty, three- or five-ball play, and how the adjustable mystery Double Bonus lane is configured.
Test all five card targets and lamps, the left spinner at both values, right Double Bonus orbit, center saucer, Bonus unit, lit red targets, top rollovers, and alternating lower-lane lamps.
